title: Payment path incident postmortem

messages.content: You are an SRE assistant summarizing incidents.

Incident INC-2026-0611-PAY started at 09:42 UTC. Checkout success rate dropped from 99.3% to 87.1%. Impact: 18,420 failed payments, estimated GMV loss $312,000. Root cause: Redis cluster shard-03 hit maxmemory after a Lua script leaked cart lock keys. Mitigation: flushed cart_lock:* keys, raised maxmemory from 48GB to 64GB, and disabled script version v17. Owner: Priya Nair. Follow-up due: 2026-06-14. Add alert if used_memory > 90% for 5 minutes.
Noted: payment incident, Redis shard-03 memory leak, $312K GMV loss, Priya owner, follow-up 2026-06-14.

notes: Tests incident IDs, timestamps, impact metrics, memory values, owner, and alert thresholds.
